faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Gorakhpur Junior Resident (Medical) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the AIIMS Gorakhpur Junior Resident (Medical) Recruitment 2026 is 31st August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Resident (Medical) post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification for the Junior Resident (Medical) post is MBBS from an MCI recognized institute. Additionally, candidates must have completed their compulsory rotatory internship and possess a valid internship completion certificate.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Resident (Medical) post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for the Junior Resident (Medical) post is 37 years. However, age relaxations are applicable for candidates belonging to SC, ST, OBC, and PwBD categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Resident (Medical) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 24 vacancies for the Non-Academic Junior Resident (Medical) post at AIIMS Gorakhpur.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Resident (Medical) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary in the Pay Matrix (Level-10) with a minimum of Rs. 56,100/- plus NPA (for medical personnel) as per the recommendations of the 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for AIIMS Gorakhpur Junior Resident (Medical) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹ 500/- for UR, EWS, and OBC categories, and ₹ 250/- for SC/ST categories. Candidates belonging to the PwBD category are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Resident (Medical) post includes an Interview and Document Verification. A written examination may also be conducted if the number of candidates is large.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the AIIMS Gorakhpur Junior Resident (Medical) posts are on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at All India Institute of Medical Sciences Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, 273008.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates carry for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry their original documents and testimonials along with self-attested photocopies of age proof, qualification, experience, and any other relevant certificates at the time of the interview.
